capabilities.wealth_summary: baraka is a DIFC-based, DFSA-regulated (Category 3C, Retail Client and client-assets endorsements) self-directed investing app for GCC retail investors, founded in 2020 by Feras Jalbout. US stocks and ETFs are held through DriveWealth LLC; since 10 Sep 2026 UAE stocks on DFM and ADX are traded via Arqaam Capital's DMA with custody at Emirates NBD. The app also offers US options, fractional bonds, physical gold and silver (SafeGold, Brink's vaults) and 'baraka Access' pre-IPO SPVs for professional investors (typically from USD 25k; SpaceX and Apptronik closed, OpenAI and Stripe upcoming). The DFSA approved an Islamic Window in Jul 2026 and the company says 58% of funded customers have used its Shariah screener. No managed portfolios, advice or funds shelf were found, and user or asset totals are not disclosed.

private_banking.detail: Not a bank; no relationship-managed or private-wealth tier found on getbaraka.com.

asset_management.detail: No own funds or managed portfolios found. Private-market deals are offered through a deal-specific SPV that baraka creates (S4); the manager of these SPVs is not named.

brokerage.detail: Self-directed brokerage. US stocks and ETFs (fractional, extended hours, fees 'starting at USD 1 per trade' per App Store) with money and securities held by a regulated third-party provider, DriveWealth LLC (terms). UAE stocks on DFM and ADX since 10 Sep 2026, via Arqaam Capital's Direct Market Access; whole shares held in customers' names, custody at Emirates NBD; investor numbers issued in onboarding. US options live. Fractional bonds listed on the App Store.

digital_investing.detail: baraka app (iOS/Android, English and Arabic) launched 3 Aug 2021; features include baraka AI, Income Center, Auto-Invest, dividend reinvestment, investor calendar, stock analysis and reports, Shariah screener. Pay-ins via Lean Technologies payment initiation.

advisory.detail: Website and terms state content is general information, not investment advice. No advisory service found.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: Auto-Invest is a recurring-purchase feature; no model or robo portfolios found. In 2022 the company said it was exploring 'asset management products' (S17).

funds_platform.detail: ETFs only; no mutual fund shelf found.

structured_products.detail: None found on website, App Store listing or terms.

private_markets.detail: baraka Access: pre-IPO and late-stage private companies via a deal-specific SPV; SpaceX and Apptronik deals shown as closed, OpenAI and Stripe as upcoming; typically from USD 25k; professional investors only. Launch date and fees not stated.

islamic_wealth.detail: DFSA approved the Islamic Window in Jul 2026; overseen by a Shariah Supervisory Board (members not named). Shariah screener covers US and UAE stocks and ETFs (not bonds or options), using a third-party data provider; about 58% of funded customers have used it. 2023 coverage also mentions a dividend purifier. More Shariah-compliant products planned.
